Key.Original: Read the published producer variables and warn when two modules disagree. Read-only and deterministic, so it runs on every machine. Default on. UNSOURCED that a cross-module disagreement is always a fault.
Key.English: Read the published producer variables and warn when two modules disagree. Read-only and deterministic, so it runs on every machine. Default on. UNSOURCED that a cross-module disagreement is always a fault.

Key.Original: Seconds between consistency samples, range 1 to 60. Default 10. The monitor runs in a per-frame handler and throttles itself to this interval. UNSOURCED.
Key.English: Seconds between consistency samples, range 1 to 60. Default 10. The monitor runs in a per-frame handler and throttles itself to this interval. UNSOURCED.

Key.Original: Also report an invariant that passes with a drift inside its tolerance and a full comparison. A no-data or out-of-scope row makes no comparison, so it is not reported. Reported at INFO, never a warning. Default off. UNSOURCED.
Key.English: Also report an invariant that passes with a drift inside its tolerance and a full comparison. A no-data or out-of-scope row makes no comparison, so it is not reported. Reported at INFO, never a warning. Default off. UNSOURCED.

Key.Original: Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes
Key.English: Enable verbose diagnostic logging (diag_log) for environment state changes

Key.Original: Log DEBUG and TRACE lines to the RPT. Values, not narration: each line carries the real inputs the code used. Off by default.
Key.English: Log DEBUG and TRACE lines to the RPT. Values, not narration: each line carries the real inputs the code used. Off by default.
